Memory of Sight

Website, WindowsOS, Mouse, Keyboard, Document camera, Zoom2025
Watch the full Performance here.

Invited by SFPC for a Fall 2025 class, OOPS! , I performed through Zoom simultaneously recorded by a document camera and a web camera. I utilized a writing tool that I developed for an earlier project called "as we speak", where synth and letters on the screen try their best to replace speech.
